title: Plan AI: AI Novel Writing
summary: Worldbuilding → outline → chapter generation → character consistency → polish
scenario: For authors writing long web novels or books who want AI efficiency without losing their own style and rights.

steps.title: Worldbuilding
steps.detail: Build the world, power system, map, character sheets and central conflicts into a 'story bible' document. Have the model interrogate the premise for plot holes and tighten internal logic.
steps.tips: Keep the bible in a separate file and attach it to every chapter generation so the book never drifts.

steps.title: Outline
steps.detail: Lay out the full book in three acts, then break into volumes and chapters, each with 'event + POV + hook'. Flag climax chapters and where foreshadowing pays off.
steps.tips: Write every chapter's hook first — when you're stuck, follow the outline.

steps.title: Chapter generation
steps.detail: Generate each draft with 'outline + setting summary + previous-chapter summary' as context, then rewrite by hand. Let AI draft the connective tissue; you write key dialogue and emotional peaks.
steps.tips: Give the model 3-5 sample passages to establish the voice — far more effective than describing style in words.

steps.title: Character consistency
steps.detail: Maintain character files (personality, catchphrases, relationships, current goals) and update before each chapter. Run a 'consistency review' pass to flag dialogue and actions that break character.
steps.tips: Store the files as structured JSON — it feeds the model most efficiently in bulk.

steps.title: Polish & proof
steps.detail: After reading through, run three review passes: logic gaps, voice consistency, typos and grammar. Use Sudowrite's rewrite features on weak passages while keeping your touch.
steps.tips: Read the polished text yourself once more — AI tends to flatten your distinctive voice.

pitfalls.title: The book drifting from the bible
pitfalls.detail: Generating without the setting invites contradictions; attach the setting summary every chapter.

pitfalls.title: Collective amnesia
pitfalls.detail: Characters forget last chapter's motives; keep character files and refresh them.

pitfalls.title: Homogenized prose
pitfalls.detail: Heavy AI writing reads alike; write the key scenes yourself, use AI for drafts.

pitfalls.title: Unclear copyright
pitfalls.detail: Some platforms restrict purely AI-generated content; check platform rules and commercial licensing.
